name: countUpNumber
title: Count Up Number
description: Hero number that counts up to a target with prefix, unit, and label. Compose whenever one real number is the point.

unit.description: Optional unit suffix (e.g. "%", "k", "M") — rendered in chartColor

label.description: Label rendered below the number — fades in 0.2→0.4 progress

chartColor.description: Color for prefix/unit accents — defaults to numberColor

hasMediaShadow.description: When true, applies stronger text-shadow for media backgrounds

labelFontSize.description: Optional override for label font size (default: getResponsiveFontSize × 1.3)
